title: Figma in the library, home news desk, overlay scrollbars, unified API keys
notes:
- Library: an AI Portal ⇄ Figma switch — the real Figma app becomes your board (stays open in the background, no reloads); Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V both ways, Snapshot → board, Pinterest and drops land in Figma, 'Send to Figma' on cards
- Home: a news desk (photo slides, release notes, roadmap, tips) replaces Explore; Continue cards open under the purple frame only
- Scrollbars: thin overlay bars everywhere — they only show while you scroll
- One API keys panel for every provider (Google, BytePlus, FLUX, Qwen, Magnific, Anthropic), key icon on every bar
- Latest renders picker and boards load cached thumbnails — no more lag
- Seedream x4: live slot strip, safe retries, slots wait for a free BytePlus lane, failed slots keep their number and reason, Cancel keeps finished images
- Fix: the Red brain hint was silently skipped whenever an input image was present (3.28.0)
